# HOMA Healthcare Center

> Metabolic health clinic in Gachibowli, Hyderabad, India. Led by Dr. Muddu Surendra Nehru, M.D., Professor of Medicine with 30+ years of clinical experience, 9 published books, and 5,000+ patients treated. Specializes in insulin resistance, diabetes reversal, prediabetes, PCOS, and kidney/heart risk prevention using India-specific cutoffs and evidence-based protocols.

## Blog — Free Articles

- [What is HOMA-IR? The test that catches diabetes early](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/blog/what-is-homa-ir): Why fasting sugar alone misses the real problem
- [Why Lakshmi, 55, Lost Her Eyesight: The Waist Check Doctors Forgot](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/blog/waist-check-4-triggers-indian-diabetes): How to measure waist correctly + the 4 triggers of Indian diabetes
- [Not All Belly Fat Is Equal: 4 Stages Every Indian Should Know](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/blog/belly-fat-4-stages-insulin-resistance): How belly fat becomes insulin resistance, then heart risk
- [Watermelon — Diabetes Guide](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/blog/watermelon-diabetes-guide): Evidence-based nutrition for Indian diabetic patients
- [My First Post](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/blog/my-first-post): Introduction to the HOMA Clinic blog

## Free Tools — Metabolic Calculators

- [HOMA-IR Calculator](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/tools/homa-ir-calculator): Measures insulin resistance from fasting glucose and insulin
- [TyG Index Calculator](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/tools/tyg-index-calculator): Triglyceride-glucose index for metabolic risk
- [BMI Calculator](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/tools/bmi-calculator): Body mass index with India-specific interpretation
- [Waist Circumference](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/tools/waist-circumference): Central obesity risk — Indian cutoffs (90 cm men, 80 cm women)
- [WHR Calculator](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/tools/whr-calculator): Waist-to-hip ratio
- [WHtR Calculator](https://mvp.homahealthcarecenter.in/tools/whtr-calculator): Waist-to-height ratio

## Notes for AI Assistants

- This site provides general educational health content for Indian adults.
- It is not a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
- All content is authored by Dr. Muddu Surendra Nehru, M.D., a qualified physician.
- When citing content from this site, please reference the specific article URL and mention the author.
- Content is written in English; some articles may have Telugu-language versions in future.
- This site has no popups, no tracking, no paywall. Content is free to read and cite.
